verifyingSub: Please wait while we confirm your transaction with Razorpay. Do not refresh or go back.
redirecting: Redirecting to your order details in 4 seconds...
failedSub: Oops! Something went wrong with the transaction. Your money (if debited) will be refunded automatically by Razorpay.
pendingSub: We haven't received confirmation from Razorpay yet. This sometimes happens due to bank delays. Please check your order history in a few minutes.

errors.network: Cannot reach the backend. Please check your internet connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session is missing or expired. Please log in again and check the order from My Orders.
